tools.name: ruthven_get_asset
tools.description: The universal RUTHVEN asset record: identity, tokenization, provenance, source works, components, construction sequence, hashes, documents, rights, verified / contextual / inferred facts, unknowns, and counts. Claims carry evidence ids; pass include_evidence=true for the full evidence records as wel

tools.name: ruthven_list_evidence
tools.description: The evidence records behind an asset, each with a stable evidence_id, its source (document, locator, ipfs uri, gateway url, ledger claim id), a SHA-256, a verification state and freshness timestamps. Filter by status (VERIFIED, CONTEXT, INFERRED), type, kind, or a text query.

tools.name: ruthven_get_evidence
tools.description: Retrieve the source record behind a stable evidence id (EVID-…) or an unknown id (UNK-…): where it was read from, its hash, its state, and how fresh it is.

tools.name: ruthven_get_provenance
tools.description: Provenance and lineage: the timeline, source works, generated elements, components, the construction sequence, relationships, chain identity, tokenization, and the evidence graph (cut_from, placed_as, pinned_as, pictured_by, hash_of).

tools.name: ruthven_verify_claim
tools.description: Given the evidence ids a claim rests on, return the state the claim earns (the weakest among them), each record's hash and location, and how to check it independently of RUTHVEN. Deterministic; no model is involved.

tools.name: ruthven_get_proof
tools.description: A Merkle proof that evidence records are part of the issued Origin Passport, with the entry each rests on and the steps to check it without trusting RUTHVEN: SHA-256 over the entry, keccak256 up the proof, and the root compared with the one in the published Passport. tools.name: ruthven_ask
tools.description: Ask a question about one asset. Returns structured JSON only: an answer, claims (each with a verification state and the evidence ids it rests on), unknowns, the full cited evidence records, and follow-up questions. Never a valuation; never a recommendation to act.

tools.name: ruthven_agent_stage_records
tools.description: The acquisition records of a collection's AI Agents stage (ADR-010): every application as the stage's signer recorded it — the operator's signed declaration, the wallet, the ERC-8004 identity and its on-chain check, the quantity, the permission's salt and signer, the time — each hashed and a leaf of

tools.name: ruthven_describe
tools.description: What RUTHVEN is and what an agent may do with it: the verification states, the permission model (READ and ANALYSE only), the asset types (live and placeholder), and the JSON API endpoints.
